project.name: Ledgerly
project.one_liner: Tiny invoicing app for freelancers: clients, line-item invoices, paid/unpaid tracking, outstanding-totals dashboard.

gates.notes: All checks green: 191 unit + 11 e2e. Q-002/Q-003/Q-005 accepted as v1.1 items per QA run-3 recommendations.

Security: 0 critical/0 high; SEC-003+SEC-009 closed in next.config.ts. 3 medium (rate limit, timing oracle) + 5 low accepted as v1.1 items. CI/container/runbook verified locally: typecheck+lint+format+build 0, 191 unit, docker build + first-boot proof green.

SEO/Marketer/Social ran in parallel, disjoint territory, no handoff collisions. Build green after SEO source changes (191 tests). Claim audit passed: 3 sampled claims trace to done tasks; no out-of-scope capability implied; zero fabricated social proof. T-029 filed: NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL missing from env.template — canonicals/sitemap ship on localhost until fixed. 21 [[TODO]]s + 7 assets outstanding for the user.

Ship-time run green: typecheck/lint/format/build 0, 191 unit + 11 e2e. 10/10 REQs shipped. Known issues: T-029 (NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL) must be fixed before first deploy; 3 medium + 5 low security findings accepted. Never deployed.

decisions.question: Q-001: sqlite-only assumptions blocking v2 Postgres?
decisions.answer: Resolved by ADR-001: portability confined to src/server/db.ts (cuid2 ids, no raw SQL, integer money, DB-backed sessions).

decisions.question: Frozen-stack toolchain incompatibility (lint could never pass)
decisions.answer: typescript 7.0.2→6.0.3, eslint 10.8.1→9.39.5; latest-that-composes over latest-absolute. Full pipeline proven green.
decisions.by: orchestrator (change request from oma-backend handoff seq 5)

decisions.question: T-026: money columns typed Int cannot hold values the API accepts, breaking the ADR-001 Postgres portability promise
decisions.answer: APPROVED: widen money/quantity columns to BigInt in data-model.md + schema + migration. Cost of not changing: ADR-001 promise is silently false, discovered only at v2 migration.

open_questions.text: Dashboard stat captions ("4 unpaid invoices") need per-status counts the frozen /dashboard shape lacks; currently rendered only when invoiceCount<=10.
Two <640px layout deviations from the mockups introduced by the responsive row-card treatment.

Invoice money columns are Prisma Int (32-bit), capping totalCents near $21.5M while the frozen contract input maxima allow a larger product. Arithmetic is exact; the column type is the ceiling. data_model is frozen.
Frozen contract worst case (100 lines x 1e14 cents) puts totalCents above Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER on the JSON wire; closing it requires an api contract change.
